title: Automated Legacy Refactoring with Devstral
business: Enterprise software teams managing large, aging codebases.
problem: High developer overhead when manually refactoring legacy modules, leading to slow feature velocity and inconsistent code quality.
solution: Deploying Devstral-Small-2505 within an OpenHands agentic scaffold to autonomously explore, analyze, and refactor legacy code blocks while maintaining functional parity.
steps: Configure a local vLLM server instance to host the Devstral-Small-2505 model.
Initialize the OpenHands docker container with the Devstral model endpoint.
Mount the legacy repository into the OpenHands sandbox environment.
Provide natural language instructions to the agent to identify and refactor specific legacy modules.
Review agent-generated pull requests for integration into the main codebase.
outcome: Increased developer capacity to focus on high-level architecture while the agent handles repetitive refactoring tasks.
limitation: The model is text-only; it cannot interpret visual UI mockups or hardware-level diagrams, requiring developers to provide explicit text-based specifications for complex UI changes.
